llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed dLazy image-generation CLI wrapper with expected cloud API use and no artifact-backed malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to api.dlazy.com and uploads of user-specified media to files.dlazy.com are clearly disclosed and proportionate for a hosted image-generation service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install uses npm/npx for @dlazy/cli pinned to version 1.2.3, with source and package links disclosed; users should still treat it as an external CLI dependency.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases include broad image-generation terms, which could cause over-selection, but the runtime instructions stay scoped to using dlazy banana2 and handling normal authentication or billing errors.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The CLI may persist an API key in ~/.dlazy/config.json, but this is disclosed, user-account scoped, and revocable; no background service, privilege escalation, or hidden persistence is described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Nano Banana 2.0 image generation/editing, and the instructions consistently describe calling the pinned dLazy CLI for text-to-image or image-to-image tasks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust the dLazy CLI and service, because prompts and any image paths you provide are sent to dLazy-hosted endpoints and the CLI can save an API key locally. Prefer npx for one-off use if you do not want a persistent global binary.
llm.findings:
[AE1] unexpected: The linked English and Chinese skill files are present locally and were inspected, so this does not support analysis evasion in the reviewed artifact.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases are real and could select this skill for generic image requests, but they are consistent with an image-generation tool and do not create a material security concern by themselves.
[P9] expected: The whitespace occurs in Markdown table alignment and long documentation lines; manual inspection found no hidden instructions or off-screen payload.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese file is a localized companion to the English file and does not instruct the agent to force a language preference.
